hero.eyebrow: Technology intelligence for builders and operators
hero.description: NexSift filters relevant changes in technology and shows what changed, why it matters and what to watch. No infinite feed: a short selection, with context and verified sources.
hero.pain: Keeping up with technology became a filtering job: the more you read, the less you understand, and nobody verifies what circulates.

topics.title: Seven areas, one radar
topics.description: Each topic is a lens on what is changing. Pick an area to see what deserves attention there.

why.titleA: Technology produces a lot of noise.
why.description: Feeds, newsletters and alerts compete for your attention. NexSift does not try to make you consume more: it tries to make you need to read less to understand better what changed.

process.title: Not everything that happens deserves your attention.
process.description: NexSift is an editorial sieve: a lot happens, almost nothing gets through. Only what changes a decision, risk, opportunity or understanding makes it to the radar.
process.scarcity: Scarcity is the point: publishing less is better than lowering the standard.

trust.title: Verified sources, not just cited ones.
trust.description: Every signal is traceable to the source that supports it. Before publishing, NexSift reopens and mechanically verifies every URL: the source is evidence, not decoration.
trust.publicationTooltip: Share of sources that were verified at publication time. Every new signal is only published when 100% of its sources pass verification. Signals published before this rule took effect may sit below 100%.
trust.verifiableTooltip: Share of original sources that remain accessible and verifiable right now. A source may have been validated at publication and later removed, moved or temporarily unavailable.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what NexSift collects and how data is handled, in line with the LGPD.
privacy.productBody: NexSift is an editorial technology intelligence product. There is no sign-up, login or any form of account; there is no per-user personalization or profile-based recommendations.
privacy.collectBody: NexSift uses PostHog to measure site usage with anonymous events: visited pages, clicks on external sources and navigation actions. The data is aggregated and does not identify you individually.
privacy.notCollectBody: We do not collect name, email, ID number, precise location or browsing data outside NexSift. We do not use advertising cookies or share data with third parties.
privacy.contentBody: Signals are produced with AI assistance from verified public sources and point to those sources. Verification is automated by the system itself and collects no data from readers. When you access external links, you leave NexSift and become subject to the respective sites' privacy policies.
privacy.retentionBody: Anonymous events are used only to understand product usage and improve the site. There is no profiling, targeted advertising or data selling.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access, correction or deletion of any data related to you at any time, through the contact email below.
privacy.updated: The current version of this policy is the one published on this page.

about.title: A technical filter, not another infinite feed
about.body: NexSift was born to reduce the cost of keeping up with technology. Instead of reproducing everything that was published, it prioritizes signals with real impact for people who build, operate, design or decide about technology, with development as the main editorial bias.
about.signalBody: A signal is a relevant change, verified and placed in context. Not everything that happens is a signal: the change must be real, have evidence and alter a decision, risk, opportunity or understanding for people who build or operate technology.
about.criteriaIntro: A signal is only published when it passes all of these criteria:
about.criteriaA: Source before opinion: evidence supports every fact, and the source is cited.
about.criteriaB: Context before volume: publishing less is better than lowering the standard.
about.criteriaC: Technical impact before hype: concrete consequence beats flashy novelty.
about.aiBody: AI researches, organizes and drafts with support; NexSift verifies. No claim is published without a verified source, and the text points to the material that supports it. Before making decisions, review the original sources; errors may occur.
about.relevanceBody: Every signal gets a relevance (how much it matters to people who build and operate technology) and a confidence (the solidity of the evidence and interpretation). Only signals with relevance 6.5 or above and confidence 7 or above make it to the radar.
about.methodBody: The flow is a sieve: a lot happens, almost nothing gets through. NexSift asks whether the change is real, whether there is evidence and whether it has consequences. What is left becomes a signal, and every signal ends by indicating what to watch next.
about.creatorTitle: Built by someone who lives the problem
about.creatorBody: NexSift was created by <name>Tiago Castro</name>, a full stack cloud developer with a degree in Systems Analysis and Development and more than 5 years in the market building and operating software. The motivation came from the cost of keeping up with technology: infinite feeds, hype and little context. NexSift is the filter he wanted for himself: few signals, verifiable sources and direct context about what changes for people who build software.
